_comment: The first objective, and for now the only one. Given by Spite on the doorstep; displayed in the Hearth; survives a loop reset, which is the whole point of it.

objectives.title: Close every anomaly in town
objectives.desc: Spite says the town is full of holes. Walk into each one and come back out of it having finished what it asked.

reward.text: The town is quiet. Spite is not going to say anything nice about it.
